player.refreshRequired: Refresh the save and try again.
player.notReady: The emulator window is not ready.
player.startTimeout: The emulator took too long to start. Stop it and try again.
player.autosaved: Game progress was automatically saved to your account.
player.saved: Game progress was saved to your account.
player.unchanged: There is no new save data.
player.editApplied: Edits were written to the game save. Reload the save inside the game; values in game memory do not change automatically.
player.syncRequired: Complete synchronization in the game window first.
player.integerPixelsHelp: Scale pixels by whole numbers. Turn off to fit the window.
player.stopHelp: Synchronize before stopping. The game window remains open if synchronization fails.
player.mouseHelp: Click the game to capture the mouse. Press Esc to release it.
player.dosSyncHelp: Changed game saves are synchronized every 30 seconds, and before stopping or leaving the game.
player.keyboardHelp: Save to account preserves the current state. Click the game to use the keyboard; see Control Settings for bindings.
